## Introduction

This is a sample presentation using the Universitas Airlangga theme.

- Clean, professional design
- Official UNAIR branding
- Easy to customize

## Key Features

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column}
**Design Elements**

- UNAIR Blue primary color
- Yellow accent highlights
- Clean typography
- Compliance with the [brand standardization](https://drive.google.com/file/u/1/d/1KcRztcsJsI0zKPWvENze6Z8dyeXw6NWz/view?usp=sharing)
:::

::: {.column}
**Smart Features**

- Auto logo placement
- White logo on blue
- Styled components
- Section dividers
:::

## Brand Colors

The theme uses official Universitas Airlangga colors:

- [UNAIR Blue (#14497F)]{.unair-blue} - Primary
- [UNAIR Yellow (#FFCB05)]{.bg-unair-yellow} - Accent
- Red (#E6282B) - Alerts

## Code Examples

R code with syntax highlighting:

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "#14497F") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Car Weight vs MPG")
```

## Overview {.text-slide-bg}

::: {.lead}
A quick summary before we dive into the details.
:::

::: {.content-box}
This study examines how open science practices affect replication rates in psychological research, drawing on a pre-registered, multi-site design.
:::

## Our Pillars {.columns-slide}

::: {.lead}
Three principles guide this research program.
:::

::: {.columns-area}
::: {.col-item}

### Rigor

Pre-registered designs and transparent analysis pipelines.
:::

::: {.col-item}

### Collaboration

:::

::: {.col-item}
